description: A DAW-style piano roll — a pitch-reference key strip beside an editable note grid, click to add notes, drag to move or resize either edge, shift-click to select and move several at once, double-click to delete — with a fixed BPM-driven loop that plays back in real time. Tap a key or connect a MIDI keyboard to audition pitches, with a mute toggle for the live preview
name: block-piano-roll
